acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Map synthetic internal phase P-3 to an approved plain-language message. Include an expected completion date only if supported and reviewed; show its basis and uncertainty. Changing the phase stages a new client update and notification under the declared approval policy. Internal strategy notes and restricted fields remain private. A notification delivered or portal opened is not proof the client read or agreed. Test two clients with different document grants and languages; translations retain source/version. No real message is published.

workflow.input: Internal phase, approved status text and client access/language settings
workflow.initial_state: Synthetic fixture and proposed application state; no live case data used
workflow.user_action: Preview and publish a client-facing progress update
workflow.output: Versioned client status and separately tracked notification/access evidence
workflow.exceptions_and_dependencies: Vendor claim only; exact fields, current UI/limits and approved legal content require independent verification.

extensions.label: Future-only rule edits
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Apply v1 to a case, publish v2 and verify existing tasks are unchanged. A later eligible transition uses v2. No retroactive tasks appear without an explicit backfill preview and approval.

extensions.label: Four trigger classes
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Test phase entry, task completion, approaching case date and manual button with stable event IDs. Repeated events cannot duplicate actions; changing a case date invalidates stale queued runs.

extensions.label: Declared actions and case-type scope
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Exercise task creation and automatic SMS separately, with role resolution and consent checks. Missing assignee produces a visible exception. Do not infer email actions from the case-rule page; lead taskflows have a separate stated email capability.

extensions.label: Role resolution on each case
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Assign the same case role to different people on two cases. Resolve each task to the correct person, retain rule/role/actor snapshots, and expose missing or inactive role members.

extensions.label: Phase-limited recurring tasks
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Run a 30-day recurrence limited to Treatment. Leaving the phase stops future occurrences according to the declared policy; preserve prior tasks. Reentry must explicitly resume or create a new series, without duplicate backdated work.

extensions.label: One-way per-user calendar publication
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Create, update and delete a case event and verify Google/Outlook receipts per user. External personal events are not imported. Tasks do not sync under this source claim. Test disconnected and partially failing users, admin event-type settings and user filters; do not label the whole team synced from one success.

extensions.label: Document page and passage navigation
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Answer from synthetic PDF-v2 page 3 and open the cited passage in that version. If the source was replaced, deleted or inaccessible, show unresolved provenance; do not redirect silently to another page or claim every answer has a document citation.

extensions.label: Current AI error disclosure
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: An unsupported fact must remain unknown; a citation is not proof that the cited text supports an inference. Require source verification and do not display a zero-hallucination guarantee.

extensions.label: Provider totals and duplicate bill boundaries
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Reconcile each visit/charge to provider and original source. Separate duplicate pages, corrected bills, billed amount, payment and lien balance. Provider counts must equal distinct reviewed identities.

extensions.label: Chronology Word export versus demand narrative
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Export the selected chronology as Word with its provider totals and source links; a chronology export alone must not be described as a generated demand narrative.

extensions.label: Correct underlying data
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Edit the provider and record values behind the timeline, retain old values and source pages, and update sort order without duplicating visits.

extensions.label: Shared extraction snapshot
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: A corrected medical charge invalidates chronology totals and all dependent demand/statement drafts. Show which artifact snapshot is current and which requires rereview.

extensions.label: Structured fields plus selected documents
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Record structured field snapshot and selected source document/version IDs. A deselected document must not influence a regenerated narrative; missing or contradictory facts remain visible.

extensions.label: Omitted empty repeat blocks
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Generate 0/1/2 defendants, providers, liens and witnesses. Confirm the declared empty-block omission and preserve role-specific field boundaries and formatting.

extensions.label: Warn before generation
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Detect a missing required date and distinguish empty, unknown and inapplicable values before generation. Firm final-release policy blocks unresolved required values; no vendor hard-block behavior is presumed from the word warning.

extensions.label: Inbound fax filing and review states
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Retain original fax, provider message ID, suggested matter and filing receipt. An unmatched or ambiguous fax stays reviewable. Distinguish received, analyzed, matched, confirmed, filed and action-approved states; no information is discarded when approval is denied.

extensions.label: Failed outbound fax recovery
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Inject provider failure after an outbound request and create a sender review item. Reconcile provider status before resend; preserve original attempt and page count. Delivered does not mean reviewed by the recipient.

extensions.label: Per-action outcomes
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Approve only filing and a review task from a fax analysis, leaving proposed lien/status changes unapproved. Show separate results; Run All cannot turn a queued human task into completed legal work.

extensions.label: Case search versus cross-case AI retrieval
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Test filename/content search with folder/type/date filters in one case and cross-case AI retrieval separately. Case restrictions must apply to snippets, citations, document bytes and counts.

extensions.label: File restore and shared version policy
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Restore prior document bytes with a new auditable version pointer and test what an existing share sees. File-change logs and share-view/download logs remain distinct and export with stable IDs.

extensions.label: Optional second copy is not a consistent restore
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Display whether the paid second storage copy is enabled and its last verified coverage. Database backup, file replication, export and a consistent application restore remain separate evidence. Restore a controlled complete set and reconcile relationships before claiming recovery; no real restore executed here.

extensions.label: Conflicting exit windows
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Record privacy 30-day versus terms 90-day post-termination export descriptions as unresolved. In the firm app expose the approved policy version, cutoff and available formats; do not promise either vendor window without contract clarification.

extensions.label: Two-part data exit
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Reconcile structured CSV and file ZIP against a manifest containing case IDs, document hashes, folder paths, communication records and exclusions. A ZIP alone is not a complete export or backup. Test migration status mappings and signed artifacts separately.

extensions.label: Thread visibility and daily-ledger completeness
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Optional activity-feed display must not suppress messages in the master daily review. Retain every individual SMS/MMS and call with exact direction, time, participants, source IDs and attachment ingestion status. Team read markers do not mean a client read an SMS.

extensions.label: Existing number and carrier prerequisites
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Track business-number texting hosting and carrier registration separately from voice service and consent. A configured number or registration submission does not prove send readiness.

extensions.label: All required signers before conversion
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Duplicate completion events create one case; a viewed link or one of two signatures cannot trigger case conversion. Store the completed envelope and certificate before post-signature tasks run.

extensions.label: Explicit rejection reasons
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Preserve rejected lead answers, origin and reason; resubmission cannot bypass an existing conflict decision. No automatic representation decision follows a star rating.

extensions.label: Absent source attribution stays absent
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: If the webhook omits UTM/click IDs, retain absence rather than infer an ad source. Record integration defaults separately from client answers, along with office assignment at conversion.

extensions.label: Consistent case restrictions
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Enforce the same firm/user/case restrictions across UI, AI, MCP, file links, exports, chat notifications and reporting. Broad organization access must not bypass a restricted matter.

extensions.label: Tab label versus behavior
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Retain Discovery, Depositions and Pleadings as individually named workspace entries. A visible tab does not prove transcript analysis, filing or service. Preserve underlying records when layouts change and mark unspecified sub-workflows pending.

extensions.label: Automatic status transitions
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Show which documented activity triggered a lead-status transition and preserve prior/new status. Unknown trigger rules remain unconfigured. Replayed events cannot advance a status twice or bypass a rejection/conflict gate.

extensions.label: Mobile intake access
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: At supported narrow viewport sizes, complete a synthetic intake with required fields, Unsure answers and validation errors intact. Keyboard/focus and readable labels must work; a mobile sales claim alone is not a passed device/browser test.

extensions.label: Outbound fax quality selection
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Record Standard versus high-quality selection in packet metadata and show unsupported-format/conversion failures before send. Verify actual provider-request setting in a controlled environment; no readability or delivery guarantee follows from selecting quality.

extensions.label: Type-tagged signing templates
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Filter test templates by intake, HIPAA and other declared tags without changing their signer fields or document version. Hidden/unapproved templates cannot be selected through a direct ID. A tag is organizational metadata, not legal approval of an authorization.

extensions.label: Expert engagement, shared materials and invoice terms
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Retain synthetic expert engagement scope, rate schedule, cancellation terms, deliverables and approved dates as versioned records. Reconcile 2.5 review hours at100.00/hour plus a500.00 report fee to750.00; flag an invoice using an unauthorized rate. Preserve exactly which document versions were shared with that expert and when. A materials-considered list must come from verified sharing/receipt or expert confirmation, not every file in the case. Legal disclosure/privilege judgments require attorney review; vendor blog statements are not controlling law.

extensions.label: Retainer fee basis and applicable tier
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Use gross300000.00 and costs50000.00 at33%:gross-basis fee99000.00 versus net-after-cost fee82500.00. Show the signed fee-term version and selected basis. Changing litigation stage cannot silently apply a new fee tier to an approved distribution. Flag unknown/disputed terms for attorney resolution; recalculate and invalidate older statements after an approved basis change.

extensions.label: Cleared funds and proposed distributions remain separate
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Track a synthetic promised300000.00 settlement, received check and separately verified clearance. A generated distribution statement cannot mark funds received, cleared or disbursed. Require the firm's declared approval/hold policy before preparing a payment. Reversed or returned funds invalidate the proposed distribution. No bank transaction or real payment is executed; the vendor article does not establish a working trust ledger or reconciliation engine.

extensions.label: Disputed liens and held amounts
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Keep asserted15000.00, negotiated10000.00 and disputed5000.00 as distinct reviewed values with sources. Model a hold/reserve only under the attorney-approved matter policy; do not treat a vendor blog as a universal legal rule requiring payment of every asserted lien. Statement versions show the unresolved/disputed status and effect on proposed net. A pending negotiation cannot be labeled lien satisfaction or verified disbursement.

extensions.label: Co-counsel audience
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Give synthetic co-counsel access to two specific files from one matter. Case membership, a referral relationship or a fee split must not expose internal notes, other cases or all later uploads. Revoke and verify future access and download URLs under the declared policy.

extensions.label: Referral fee base and split reconciliation
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Use a100000.00 recovery and reviewed one-third attorney fee, then a25% referral share of that fee. Retain exact rational arithmetic and declared rounding; shares must reconcile to the rounded fee. A referral percentage of fee must not silently become a percentage of gross recovery. Unknown agreement/approval blocks final release.

extensions.label: Obligation versus payment
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Record a referral fee as proposed, approved, due and paid using separate evidence. Generating a statement cannot mark payment issued or cleared. Reconcile a returned payment without erasing the original attempt.

extensions.label: Contingent revenue forecast
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Label synthetic 30/60/90-day forecasts with as-of date, probability/expected-close basis and reviewer. Distinguish case value, firm fee, recovered expenses, expected revenue and collected cash. Reopen/delay cases without counting the same recovery twice; stale estimates remain visible.

extensions.label: Preserve time despite contingency model
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Keep every individual call, text and email/document interval in the daily review, even on a contingency matter. Include reviewed labor cost in a proposed profitability report with explicit rates and overlap rules. A vendor statement minimizing hourly billing never removes the firm's time-review requirements.

extensions.label: Portal upload is a distinct proposed path
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: For a synthetic client upload, require durable receipt, original hash, matter/grant checks and extraction status before claiming filed. The blog describes upload as a recommended portal feature, not a demonstrated InTrial upload flow; implementation and competitor availability both remain unverified.

extensions.label: Appointment requests remain requests
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Track a proposed portal appointment request separately from confirmation and external calendar sync. Recheck authority, timezone, attendee scope and duplicate requests. This is a design safeguard derived from general portal guidance; no InTrial booking capability is proven.

extensions.label: Adoption versus access metrics
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Record onboarding invitation, successful activation, notification, portal visit, document view and message reply as distinct events. Do not treat invitation delivery as adoption or imply the article's call-reduction percentage was measured in this firm.

extensions.label: Distinct limitation-date bases
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Keep incident date, death date and attorney-approved claim-specific trigger/basis separately. A generic year preset cannot resolve survival/wrongful-death/probate differences. Unknown governing law or tolling stays unresolved; changes stage a reviewed reminder update.

extensions.label: Preparation status is not testimony completion
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Record synthetic witnesses as availability-unknown, scheduled, prepared, unavailable and testified with supporting event evidence. A prep task completed cannot mark testimony given or subpoena served. Keep each witness's report version and schedule distinct.

extensions.label: Reverse-calendar change review
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Build synthetic prep deadlines from a reviewed trial date and explicit offsets. Moving trial produces a preview of changed, unchanged, completed and manually overridden items; never silently shift a filed deadline or erase historical tasks.

extensions.label: Deposition designations versus playback
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Store proposed witness testimony designations with exact transcript version/page/line and, only where verified, linked video timestamps. Missing video alignment is explicit; no excerpt or playback success may be inferred from the article's recommendation to prepare designations.
